extension.description: RTL, FPGA and SoC development in VS Code: browse Vivado projects, navigate HDL source, and inspect module connections.
command.explainModule: Explain Module with AI (Source and Project Context)
command.svLint: Run Configured Vendor Lint on Current HDL File
command.openDefinition: Go to Module Definition (double click / right-click)
config.title: Vivado Project Explorer
config.ai.enabled: Automatically initialize AI integration when VS Code opens (start the tool and restore the project session). When disabled, AI starts only when you trigger it manually.
config.ai.tool: AI tool used by the extension. OpenCode is the default.
config.ai.tool.claude: Claude Code: headless claude -p mode with session resume support.
config.ai.tool.opencode: OpenCode (default): sends messages through its HTTP API and restores the project's TUI session on activation.
config.ai.tool.dsh: DeepSeek Harness. Configure vivadoProjectExplorer.ai.dsh.command to use it.
config.ai.tool.zcode: ZCode. Configure vivadoProjectExplorer.ai.zcode.command to use it.
config.ai.tool.generic: Custom command adapter configured with vivadoProjectExplorer.ai.generic.command.
config.ai.autoFallback: Try another available AI tool when the configured tool cannot start.
config.ai.dsh.command: Command template for DeepSeek Harness. Leave empty to disable this adapter.
config.ai.zcode.command: Command template for ZCode. Leave empty to disable this adapter.
config.exportMode: Where selected Block Design files are exported.
config.exportCommand: VS Code command to invoke when exportMode is command. The file list is passed as an argument.
config.sv.enabled: Run Slang syntax diagnostics for open Verilog and SystemVerilog editor text. This does not refresh the project hierarchy or Block Design.
config.sv.intelliSense: Enable project-aware SystemVerilog navigation, semantic highlighting, completion, signature help, and rename. Enabled by default; disable it to reduce background semantic indexing.
config.sv.intelliSenseDebounce: Wait until editing pauses before rebuilding the project semantic index.
config.sv.debounce: Delay syntax analysis until the editor has been idle for this many milliseconds.
config.sv.dimInactiveCode: Dim code excluded by Slang conditional preprocessing using the current project macros and include context. Does not refresh the project hierarchy or Block Design.
config.sv.standard: SystemVerilog language revision used for Slang syntax checks.
config.sv.fileList: Optional generic simulator/synthesis .f file list. Relative paths are resolved from the workspace folder; its source order, nested lists, defines, include paths, top, and library search settings provide editor and vendor-lint context.
config.sv.lintMode: Slang provides generic syntax checks by default. Optional vendor diagnostics can be added or disabled.
config.sv.vendor: Optional vendor/tool diagnostics backend; it does not affect generic Slang parsing. Configure its executable path below.
config.sv.vendorTrigger: Run external tools manually or after saving. External tools never run on each keystroke.
config.sv.target: Synthesis or simulation file context used by the external lint adapter.
config.sv.toolPath: Executable path for the selected external lint tool. For Vivado, use xvlog.bat; paths and macro arguments are passed through a temporary response file.
config.sv.toolArgs: Argument array for Quartus/custom adapters. Supports {file}, {files}, {projectRoot}, {top}, {target}, {standard}, {includeDirs}, {defines}, {libraryDirs}, {libraryFiles}, {libraryExtensions}, and {libraryNames}.
config.sv.timeout: Maximum runtime for one external lint invocation; the process is terminated when it expires.
